digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend assembly and port validation
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend @runtime_checkable Protocol because it lacks query_project and assert_env_ready members that Cloud's JiraBackend implements
DC inbound assignees carry name/key but no accountId, causing the identity-mint guard to return early and silently skip minting, unlike Cloud which mints ghost identities
The reconciler.backend configuration validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' despite the backend being registered and resolvable, making it unreachable from config
DC inbound identities must mint under the shared 'jira' creation channel family to preserve unified store vocabulary, not fork a per-deployment 'jira-datacenter' channel

The TicketTransport Protocol declares six members but production code calls set_entity_property from three core sites, making protocol conformance necessary but insufficient for operational correctness
A live dry-run pass against real Jira DC succeeds but a writing pass crashes on the undeclared set_entity_property method, proving unit-tier greenpaths miss operational defects
